info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Knowledge Asset Intellectual Property Portfolio-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of knowledge asset intellectual property portfolios, enabling businesses to manage their intellectual resources effectively. By allowing users to submit detailed information about various intellectual properties, it supports the organization and categorization of valuable assets. Typical consumers include enterprises and legal teams seeking to streamline their IP portfolio management processes. This endpoint not only enhances visibility of assets but also aids in strategic decision-making regarding intellectual property investments.

post.summary: Create a new intellectual property portfolio.
post.description: This operation allows users to create a new intellectual property portfolio, storing crucial information and managing various assets as part of the overall knowledge assets framework.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new entry in the intellectual property portfolio. It should contain the necessary details about the intellectual property assets being submitted, formatted as specified in the schema.
